```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

Create new columns for monthly measurements
```{r}
fish <- fish %>% 
  group_by(domainID, siteID, year, month) %>% 
  summarise(fish_month_tally = n())

plant <- plant %>% 
  drop_na(aquaticPlantType) %>% 
  group_by(domainID, siteID, year, month) %>% 
  summarise(plant_month = count(aquaticPlantType))

discharge <- discharge %>% 
  drop_na(dischargeContinuous) %>% 
  group_by(domainID, siteID, year, month) %>% 
  summarise(discharge_month = sum(dischargeContinuous))

```

Join datasets together
```{r}
fish_plant <- left_join(fish, plant, by = c("domainID", "siteID", "month", "year"))

discharge_fish_plant <- left_join(discharge, fish_plant, by = c("domainID", "siteID", "month", "year"))
```

Create a test plot before analysis
```{r}
discharge_fish_plant %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = fish_month, y = plant_month)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  scale_x_continuous("Total Fish per Month") +
  scale_y_continuous("Total Plant per Month") +
  personal_theme
```
